title: Co-Credit metering, budgets, usage receipts, and commercial controls
objective: Meter expensive compute with explicit estimates, reservations, caps, settlement, and auditable integer Co-Unit receipts while collaboration remains free.

obligations.title: Billable operations estimate, reserve, commit actual usage or release, and issue a receipt
obligations.residualRisk: Expensive operations can run without consent, budget authority, or an explainable usage record.

obligations.title: Reservations, retries, provider reconciliation, caps, and shared budgets remain exact under concurrency
obligations.residualRisk: Parallel jobs and retries can overspend caps or double-charge a project.

obligations.title: Rate versions, entitlements, grants, receipts, disputes, and agent spend are immutable and replayable
obligations.residualRisk: Commercial decisions cannot be reconstructed or disputed fairly without immutable rate and usage lineage.

slos.indicator: Completed billable operations without a settled usage receipt
